			<div class="fusion-title title fusion-title-18 fusion-sep-none fusion-title-text fusion-title-size-three">
<h3 class="fusion-title-heading title-heading-left">Delicious Food</h3>
<h3 class="fusion-title-heading title-heading-left"><span style="color: #868686; font-size: 15px;">Six breakfasts and six dinners are included.</span></h3>
</div>
<div class="fusion-text fusion-text-24">
<p>For breakfast in Cape Verde, you can&#8217;t miss cachupa stew accompanied by a fried egg and chorizo  “from the land ” and couscous a traditional cake, made with corn flour, papaya jam and a cup of coffee to keep your batteries charged.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Our meals are served in the best restaurants of Sal Rei<span class="Apple-converted-space">  </span>you can enjoy the excellent Cape Verdean cuisine is the result of centuries of African, Creole and Portuguese influences, the basis of its gastronomy lies in fresh ingredients of local origin, the islands are rich in fruits and vegetables Papaya, bananas, sweet potatoes, beans, corn are often used to make traditional dishes. Fresh fish and seafood are abundant on the islands and are the basis of many delicious dishes and Cape Verdean sweets are a temptation for dessert lovers.</p>
</div>
		</div>
	</div>
